verdict.rationale: The pricing page mentions 'Deploy anywhere... Your VPC' suggesting some self-managed deployment option, but there is no documentation of open-source licensing, Docker/Helm install steps, or self-host setup guides for the core Zep memory service itself (Graphiti is a separate open-source project, not the hosted 'core product'). Missing for 10: explicit self-host installation docs, source availability/license for core Zep, and independent confirmation of self-hosted deployments.
